name: Kasm Workspaces
description: Run disposable, isolated browser sessions and desktops in the browser — great for opening sketchy links away from your real machine.
compose:
services:
  kasm:
    image: kasmweb/workspaces:1.16.1
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:80"
    environment:
      KASM_ADMIN_PASSWORD: "${{cfg.admin_pass}}"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/opt/kasm/current/config
    privileged: true
    restart: unless-stopped
